messages:
Nina Patel: Quick sync  NovaCure is asking for a POC to migrate from VectorAPI to Redwood. Must keep exact streaming contract (their client expects 'out', 'meta_info', 'end_stream' events), identical token accounting behavior, FHIR JSON passthrough with schema validation, EU-only processing, and a BYOK HSM option (PKCS#11). Target: 3-week trial. Who can run the tech lead?
Egor Ivanov: I can take lead. Will implement a Vector-compatible facade that maps Vector endpoints to Redwood and emits identical SSE events. Need a sample of their streaming frames + tokenization corner cases (subword differences).
Sam Ortega: Sales note  they want pricing parity guarantee for 45 days and an engineering migration credit to offset integration effort. Suggest 25% credit first 45 days + engineering allowance. Also need per-tenant quotas preserved.
Priyanka Rao: Infra will provision a Dedicated eu-central slice and pin model rdx-3.1-small for the POC. I'll tune batching and KV cache to match token throughput. infra-bot: Dedicated eu-central slice requested (ticket #51299). ETA 48h.
Egor Ivanov: Example shim curl for testing:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST \
  https://poc.redwood.local/vector/v1/stream \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: tc-123" \
  -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>","stream":true}'
```
Egor Ivanov: SSE mapping plan: preserve event names and meta fields exactly. Pseudo:```js
if (rdxFrame.delta) send("data: " + JSON.stringify({out: rdxFrame.delta}) + "\n\n");
if (rdxMeta) send("event: meta_info\n data: " + JSON.stringify(rdxMeta) + "\n\n");
if (rdxFrame.final) send("event: end_stream\n data: {}\n\n");
```
Priyanka Rao: SecurityBot, can we support PKCS#11 BYOK for Private deployments? Also need DPA + 24mo immutable logs.
SecurityBot: Confirmed  Private deployment supports customer HSM via PKCS#11 (requires ops addendum). SOC2 Type II in place. DPA addendum required for 24mo immutable logs and EU-only processing. Provide DPO contact.
Nina Patel: Buyer blocker: Vector uses slightly different tokenization which affects billing and truncation. Need a plan to measure tokenization delta and surface per-prompt token diffs.
Egor Ivanov: Plan: run tokenization diff tool on their 1.5k prompt corpus, then normalize by mapping common subword splits and instrument per-request token attribution. Also add a fallback that truncates to safer token budget when differences exceed threshold.
Sam Ortega: Evaluation metrics requested: token-cost delta, latency P95, schema pass rate for FHIR passthrough, clinical intent F1, and unexpected hallucination count on 600 labeled prompts.
Egor Ivanov: Timeline: Week0 infra + shim; Week1 streaming parity smoke + schema tests; Week2 evaluation A/B runs; Week3 decision + contracting.
Sam Ortega: I'll draft pricing language and migration credit proposal and post here by EOD.
Priyanka Rao: I'll aim to have infra ready in 48h. Egor, let's sync on sample frames so I can run smoke tests.
Nina Patel: Scheduling kickoff with NovaCure for Monday 09:00 CET. Marking this thread as canonical POC thread. Will upload sample frames and DPO contact when received.
